Oncology (Cancer) / Hematologic Malignancies Approval Notifications

The following are approval notifications from the Oncology Center of Excellence.

2026

  • On September 3, 2026, the Food and Drug Administration approved examplimab (Examplo, Example Pharma) for adult patients with locally advanced or metastatic urothelial carcinoma who have progressed on platinum-containing chemotherapy.
  • On August 28, 2026, FDA granted accelerated approval to cartcel (Carty, Cell Co), a BCMA-directed CAR T-cell therapy, for adults with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma after four or more prior lines of therapy.
